segments.title: 第57章 請客吃飯
segments.content:
Chapter 57: Treating Someone to a Meal

In the evening, the military training ended.

Li Luo followed the crowd, walking out of the athletic field, and saw Ying Chanxi and Qiao Xinyan waiting for him from afar.

As he got closer, Li Luo felt that Ying Chanxi's gaze was a little strange, as if she wasn't looking at him, but at what was behind him.

So Li Luo turned his head in confusion, only to discover that Yan Zhusheng had been silently following behind him. When she saw him stop, she stopped as well.

"Why are you following me?" Li Luo asked with a laugh.

"I'm not following you." Yan Zhusheng shook her head, then pointed at Ying Chanxi. "I wanted to ask her to eat together."

"Oh." Li Luo remembered his suggestion from the morning. "Treating her?"

"Yes," Yan Zhusheng nodded.

"She wants to treat you to a meal," Li Luo said, looking at Ying Chanxi. "To thank you for buying her sunscreen."

"Okay," Ying Chanxi agreed readily and nodded. "Then thank you."

After speaking, Ying Chanxi walked forward, affectionately looped her arm through Yan Zhusheng's, and then brought Qiao Xinyan along. The three girls headed toward the cafeteria.

Feeling the surging tide of gazes from all around, Qiao Xinyan sighed and couldn't help but say, "I feel like I shouldn't be walking with you two."

Ying Chanxi or Yan Zhusheng alone were already eye-catching enough.

Now, with the two girls walking arm in arm, they were truly a beautiful sight, making it hard for people to look away.

Ying Chanxi wasn't short, standing at about one-sixty-two, but she seemed much more petite walking next to Yan Zhusheng.

Her cute, goose-egg-shaped face looked full and rosy, her skin as white as a freshly boiled egg, making one want to take a bite.

Yan Zhusheng, on the other hand, was tall at one-seventy, with very long and slender legs. Aside from a modest chest, her body proportions could be described as perfect.

She had a cool, melon-seed-shaped face and skin so white it was almost translucent, like a pure lotus on a snowy peak—so white it felt cold, making people afraid to get close.

Qiao Xinyan wasn't unattractive either; she had fresh and delicate features, and her mushroom-cut hair made her look sweet and well-behaved.

It was just that when walking beside the other two, she was completely relegated to being the green leaves that set off the red flowers, paling in comparison.

"You need to be confident, Classmate Qiao Xinyan," Li Luo said as he followed the three girls, walking at a leisurely pace. "One must not only pursue external beauty but also possess a clean and pure soul. In that respect, you're definitely not any worse than those two."

Qiao Xinyan covered her mouth and chuckled, then turned her head to ask, "So what you're saying is, Chanxi and the other girl's souls aren't clean?"

"Ahem... I don't know about Yan Zhusheng," Li Luo said, "but Ying Chanxi's is definitely not that clean."

"What do you mean?" Ying Chanxi turned her head back and glared at him. "Are you looking for a beating?"

"Look, look," Li Luo pointed. "Just in the virtue of tolerance alone, she still has a long way to go."

"Haha~" Qiao Xinyan was amused by the two of them.

Ying Chanxi huffed, quickened her pace, and pulled Yan Zhusheng and Qiao Xinyan into the cafeteria, not bothering to reply to him.

The four of them went up to the second floor to queue. Qiao Xinyan ordered her food, swiped her card, and went to save some seats.

Yan Zhusheng and Ying Chanxi followed behind and ordered their dishes.

Taking out her meal card from her pants pocket, Yan Zhusheng helped Ying Chanxi swipe it. Li Luo, who was next to them, began ordering his food, then looked at Yan Zhusheng, who was about to put her card back in her pocket, and asked with a raised eyebrow, "So you're only treating her?"

"Do you want me to?" Yan Zhusheng froze for a moment, then looked down at her meal card and passed it to Li Luo. "Here you go."

Before Li Luo could say anything else, Ying Chanxi had already reached out, pulled Yan Zhusheng's hand back, and shot Li Luo a glare. "He wasn't the one who bought the sunscreen. Just treating me is fine."

As she said this, Ying Chanxi took out her own meal card, slapped it on the card reader, and glared at Li Luo. "Hurry up, stop dawdling."

"Alright, alright." Li Luo shrugged, accepting the use of Ying Chanxi's meal card without any qualms.

As for Yan Zhusheng, his relationship with her wasn't close enough to casually scrounge a meal off her. Even if Ying Chanxi hadn't pulled her hand back, Li Luo wouldn't have actually taken it. He was just joking.

The three of them carried their meal trays and walked toward Qiao Xinyan.

In the queue, Shao Heqi was standing silently, watching the three of them walk past him.

Ever since Li Luo became class president and Shao Heqi failed to be elected as vice president, his presence in the class had diminished significantly.

Mainly because after starting high school, this Li Luo fellow was just too dazzling.

Not only did he become class president, but he also managed the class in an orderly fashion, brought free drinks and ice cream for his classmates, and just yesterday morning, he had even prepared belts for everyone in class.

Although Shao Heqi was reluctant, when he was walking out of the dormitory complex yesterday morning, Li Luo had called out his name, so he had shamelessly accepted the other's goodwill.

But there was something he couldn't quite figure out.

He had mocked Li Luo so much before, yet the guy seemed to have completely disregarded it. Now that he was in charge, he hadn't done anything to him.

But it was precisely this attitude of disregard and treating everyone equally that made Shao Heqi extremely uncomfortable.

It was as if a little dog on the roadside was yapping furiously at someone, but not only did the person not mind, he even smiled and threw the sausage in his hand to the dog.

At this moment, watching the retreating backs of Li Luo, Ying Chanxi, and Yan Zhusheng, Shao Heqi silently averted his gaze. Like a stray dog, he drooped his ears and hid in a corner to lick his wounds.

He secretly clenched his fists, vowing to work hard. Even if he couldn't beat Li Luo in the competition for class president, he would at least study hard and strive to surpass Li Luo in academics once again.

Li Luo had only scored 555 on the high school entrance exam, which was an exceptional performance for him.

With just a little effort, he could totally crush Li Luo in terms of grades.

By then, Shao Heqi wouldn't have to feel like he did now, where the air was filled with Li Luo's presence, making it hard to even breathe in class.

And while he was making this resolution, the three of them did not notice Shao Heqi's presence. They carried their meal trays, found the seats Qiao Xinyan had saved, and sat down to eat dinner.

"Are you going to play the guitar tonight?" Ying Chanxi asked Li Luo during the meal.

Before Li Luo could speak, Qiao Xinyan's eyes lit up beside them, and she asked curiously, "Li Luo can play the guitar?"

"I just play a little, casually," Li Luo said with a laugh.

After all, Yan Zhusheng was right there, so he didn't dare show off with the guitar. It was better to be a bit more modest.

"Li Luo is really good at playing the guitar," Ying Chanxi recalled the time she heard Li Luo sing and play on the rooftop, unable to help but say, "He can even sing while playing."

"Wow~ What a shame." Qiao Xinyan exclaimed, then shook her head helplessly. "If only Li Luo were in our Class One."

"That's asking for a bit much." The corner of Li Luo's mouth twitched. "Is Class One a place for just any 'ordinary person'?"

Sitting opposite him, Yan Zhusheng heard what he said and paused, looking inexplicably dazed. Then she asked blankly, "If a person from Class One isn't from 'a class' of people, then what class are they from?"

Qiao Xinyan: "..."

Ying Chanxi: "..."

Li Luo: "...You're so humorous."
